info.title: Play Yourself API
info.description: Replay your own saving and investing habits through past market shocks. All forward-looking outputs are modelled scenarios from similar past periods. They are not forecasts, not financial advice. Every response uses one envelope.

get.description: Per-source health and whether each source runs in mock or live mode.
Everything the dashboard tab needs. Pence values are for the local UI only.
The only object that leaves the device: ratios and 0-100 scores, no amounts.

post.description: Replay your habits under each strategy. Index is TWR rebased to 100.
Modelled scenarios from similar past periods. Not a forecast.
Plain-English explanation of a result. The AI only explains; it never computes.

get.description: Me plus friend personas, ranked by overall habit score. No amounts anywhere.

put.description: Opt in or out of sharing your asset-class pie (percentages only).

get.description: Exactly the payload that would leave the device.
Per source: effective mode, masked credential hint and the latest health result.

post.description: Paste a Monzo playground access token. Validated before it is stored.
Paste a Trading212 API key (and optional secret). Validated before it is stored.

delete.description: Forget stored credentials (memory and disk) and revert this source to demo data.

get.description: Redirect to Monzo's authorisation page. Needs MONZO_CLIENT_ID.
Validate the single-use state, exchange the code, store tokens, return to the UI.
Spending analysis over the last N complete months. Pence values: local UI only.
